sections.label: PUB mandate and water plants
sections.summary: PUB gets an expanded mandate to defend coasts against rising sea levels, and desalination and NEWater plants will number 10 by year end.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: First, as I had announced during my COS speech a few days ago, PUB will be given an expanded mandate to defend our coasts against rising sea levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Second, as PUB continues to diversify Singapore’s water sources, the number of desalination and NEWater plants has increased.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: There will be 10 such plants by the end of the year, up from seven in February 2018.

sections.label: Coastal and Flood Protection Fund
sections.summary: A Coastal and Flood Protection Fund will be set up within PUB with an initial $5 billion injection from the FY2020 Budget.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: To provide for the substantial capital outlay and implement coastal and flood protection in a fiscally sustainable manner, Deputy Prime Minister announced in his Budget speech that a Coastal and Flood Protection Fund will be set up within PUB, with an initial injection of $5 billion from the Government's FY2020 Budget.

sections.label: Climate adaptation cost estimate
sections.summary: The Prime Minister said climate change adaptation might cost $100 billion or more over the next 100 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Prime Minister mentioned at the National Day Rally last year that climate change adaptation might cost $100 billion or more over the next 100 years.

sections.label: Controller notification to PUB
sections.summary: A person becoming a substantial or indirect controller of designated parties owning DBOO plants must notify or seek PUB approval.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: First, a person who becomes a substantial controller or indirect controller of the designated parties that own and operate the DBOO plants will need to notify or seek approval from PUB.

sections.label: Minister's Special Administration Orders
sections.summary: The Minister will be empowered to issue Special Administration Orders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Third, the Minister will be empowered to issue Special Administration Orders (SAOs).

sections.label: Smart water meter powers
sections.summary: Clauses 2, 5, 6, 7 and 11 extend PUB's water meter powers to smart water meters, supporting deployment of some 300,000 meters from next year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Clauses 2, 5, 6, 7 and 11 will update the Public Utilities Act to extend existing powers of PUB in relation to water meter installation, maintenance and enforcement to cover smart water meters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These powers will support PUB’s Smart Water Meter Programme, the first phase of which involves the deployment of some 300,000 meters, starting from next year, in new and existing residential, commercial and industrial premises.

sections.label: Higher penalty for water tank offences
sections.summary: Clause 10 adds section 45A, raising the maximum penalty for water tank offences to a $50,000 fine, 12 months' imprisonment, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Clause 10 introduces a new section 45A to provide increased deterrence and enhance the security of water tanks by raising the maximum penalty amount for such offences to a fine of $50,000, or imprisonment of up to 12 months, or both.

sections.label: Amendments let PUB safeguard water
sections.summary: The proposed amendments will allow PUB to continue its mission of safeguarding water security and ensuring a safe, reliable water supply.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Ultimately, these proposed amendments will allow PUB to continue to fulfil its mission of safeguarding our water security, and ensuring a safe and reliable supply of water for all.

sections.label: PM on coastal defence costs
sections.summary: At last year's National Day Rally, the Prime Minister said coastal defences may cost $100 billion or more over 100 years.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: During the National Day Rally last year, our Prime Minister mentioned that coastal defences may cost $100 billion or more over 100 years.

sections.label: PUB desalination and NEWater plants
sections.summary: By this year, PUB will have three desalination plants and three NEWater plants under the Design-Build-Own-Own-Operate model.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: By this year, PUB will have three desalination plants, and three NEWater plants under the Design-Build-Own-Operate (DBOO) model.

sections.label: Oversight of DBOO plants
sections.summary: The amendments will allow PUB to be informed of, or approve, companies or persons gaining significant control of critical water infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It is important for us to strengthen oversight of these DBOO plants.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I note that the amendments to the Bill will now allow PUB to be informed of, or to give approval to companies or persons gaining significant control of these critical water infrastructure.

sections.label: Minister's Special Administration Orders
sections.summary: The Bill lets the Minister issue Special Administration Orders so the Government can ensure water security, including keeping DBOO plants operating.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Bill also introduces powers for the Minister to issue Special Administration Orders under certain circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This will allow the Government to take steps to ensure that Singapore’s water security is not compromised, such as by ensuring that the DBOO plants continue to operate regardless of circumstances.

sections.label: Coastal and Flood Protection Fund funding
sections.summary: The Fund starts with $5 billion, and the Government is asked how it will ensure enough money over the long haul.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Their hard work and thrift have made it possible for us to commence on ambitious projects like this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: We have started with $5 billion for this Fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Prime Minister Lee had estimated that coastal defence might cost us $100 billion or more over 100 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: How is the Government going to ensure that we will have enough money in the long haul to sustain this Fund?

sections.label: Coastal protection and drainage infrastructure examples
sections.summary: The Minister is asked for examples of coastal protection and drainage infrastructure to be financed by the Fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Would the Minister tell us what are some examples of the types of coastal protection and drainage infrastructure which will be financed by the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund?

sections.label: Generation's contribution to Singapore's survival
sections.summary: The $5 billion injection from this term of Government is this generation's contribution towards safeguarding Singapore's continued survival.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The $5 billion injection from this term of Government represents our generation’s contribution towards safeguarding Singapore’s continued survival.

sections.label: Combination of funding tools
sections.summary: The Fund will not be the only funding source; funding tools include the Fund, borrowing, budget and past reserves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Given the significant outlay required, the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund will not be the only source of funding.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have to use a combination of funding tools – the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund, borrowing, budget from the Government-of-the-day, as well as past reserves for measures such as land reclamation.

sections.label: Ring-fencing and annual Fund utilisation
sections.summary: Legislative amendments will ring-fence the Fund for coastal and drainage flood protection, and PUB will publish utilisation annually.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: First, it will be ring-fence through this legislative amendments to fund expenditures relating to coastal and drainage flood protection measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: PUB will publish the Fund utilisation annually in a separate section in its financial statements.

sections.label: Safeguards over DBOO plants
sections.summary: A review observed the Government lacked legislative safeguards for critical water infrastructure under the Public Utilities Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As part of our regular review of the safeguards over DBOO plants, we observe that, unlike other critical infrastructure, the Government did not have legislative safeguards for critical water infrastructure under the Public Utilities Act.

sections.label: DBOO oversight review timing
sections.summary: The review to enhance oversight over DBOO plants began well before the Hyflux situation emerged.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The review to enhance our oversight over DBOO plants started way before the Hyflux situation emerged.

sections.label: Special Administration Order grounds
sections.summary: The Minister can impose Special Administration Orders on four grounds, including inability to pay debts and public emergency.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The grounds under which the Minister can impose Special Administration Orders are: first, the designated party is or is likely to be unable to pay its debts; second, the occurrence of a public emergency; third, the Minister considers it in the interest of the security and reliability of the supply of water in Singapore; and fourth, the Minister considers it in the public interest.

sections.label: PUB contractual remedies and Bill
sections.summary: PUB will rely on Water Purchase Agreement remedies as far as possible, and the Bill advances PUB's expanded roles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: PUB will continue to rely on existing contractual remedies under the Water Purchase Agreements as far as possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This Bill is an important step forward as PUB builds up its coastal and flood protection role, strengthens its oversight over water concession companies, implements smart water meters and enhances the security of our water tanks.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Will PUB be employing more engineers so as to build up our in-house technical capability or would we be farming out the consultancy work?

sections.label: Building in-house capabilities
sections.summary: New functions will be supported by in-house capabilities while cooperating with parties that can value-add.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: With these new functions that we have taken up, we will certainly build the capabilities in-house, but we will not ignore cooperating with any other parties that can value-add to our functions.      .
